summary: The development shall be no closer than 2,640 feet from an approved high-capacity transit station.
text: The development shall be no closer than 2,640 feet from an approved high-capacity transit station.
notes: Adopted unchanged from the staff proposal. Data centers are permitted in the C-2, C-3, CP/GCP, A-1 and A-2 districts by Special Permit granted by Council on Commission recommendation. Atlanta separately bars data centers within a half mile of transit stations; these are the only two transit-spacing provisions identified in this corpus.
confidence_note: Codification read, not the enrolled ordinance. What qualifies as an approved high-capacity transit station, and how the distance is measured, are not defined in this section.
